**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties, or fixed-sum remedies on Mortgage Logic.com as Client:

- **§14 (Termination)** — Client may terminate on written notice, with services running only to the end of the following month. No early-termination fee, no minimum-term buyout, no remaining-contract-value exposure.
- **§7 / §8(f) (Spamming)** — the likeliest home for per-message penalties, but these are pure covenants; TrueLink only "reserves all legal and equitable rights," i.e., actual damages, not stipulated amounts.
- Document-wide searches for "liquidated damages," "penalty," "damages," and "Client shall pay" returned nothing.

Two items noted in the rationale but deliberately **not** flagged under this rule, as they are fee mechanics rather than liquidated damages:
- §5(a) blank minimum monthly fees ("not less than $____ per month") — worth completing and sizing against the one-month termination runway.
- §6 requires Client to pay contested amounts timely (pay-to-dispute), and excludes the minimum monthly fees from both documentation and challenge rights.
